messages:
🎉 Barcelona · Sat 28 Nov
Tomorrow is general-election day (29N, per Barcelona Secreta) and Barça play away at Deportivo, Sun 16:15 — a quieter Sunday, so tonight is the big one.

TODAY · Sat 28 Nov

1. SOUNDIT Plaza: Joy Orbison, Aurora Halal, TRS, EYRA
🕘 Today 16:00 → 22:00 · 📍 Plaza Monumental de Barcelona
📊 2,092 interested on RA · RA Pick · also on DICE
💶 18€, 22€, 25€, 28€, 32€
💬 Open-air daytime rave in the old bullring with Joy Orbison headlining; the biggest crowd on RA today and featured by Planes en Barcelona. Expect a few thousand; a tardeo-style session that ends in time for a club.
https://ra.co/events/2480242

2. Catupecu Machu
🕘 Sat 21:00 · 📍 Razzmatazz (Sala 2 on most listings)
📊 Listed for tonight by Songkick and La Ganzúa, tickets still on sale
💶 From €38.99
💬 Argentine rock veterans on a rare Spanish date, so the crowd will be overwhelmingly Argentine. Mid-size room, expect several hundred. Cielo Razzo (Rosario) also play Apolo's La 2 at 19:30 if you want a double.
https://songkick.com/concerts/43337658-catupecu-machu-at-razzmatazz-2

3. Carolina Durante — Fin de la aventura (tour finale)
🕘 Sat 21:00 (doors 19:00) · 📍 Palau Sant Jordi
📊 Arena show at Palau Sant Jordi, listed by Time Out and La Ganzúa
💶 From €38
💬 Spain's biggest indie-rock band closing their tour in the arena: thousands of locals shouting every chorus. The largest single crowd in the city tonight; I could not confirm how many tickets are left.
https://www.laganzua.net/conciertos/carolina-durante-barcelona-1014063

4. Adam Beyer presents Drumcode - Hivernacle Barcelona
🕘 Tonight 22:00 → 04:00 · 📍 Plaza Mayor de El Poble Espanyol
📊 1,700 interested on RA
💬 Adam Beyer's Drumcode label takes over the Poble Espanyol square for Hivernacle's season closing. Big-name techno, open-air; expect a couple of thousand on the strength of the RA interest.
https://ra.co/events/2554309

5. TARDEIG ELECTRÒNIC X Chica Club Presents: Classics
🕘 Tonight 18:00 → 00:00 · 📍 Chica Club
📊 268 interested on RA · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Free tardeo of house and disco classics, 18:00 to midnight. Solid RA interest for a free afternoon session, likely a couple of hundred; easy first stop before a concert or club.
https://ra.co/events/2567218

TOMORROW · Sun 29 Nov

1. CHURROS CON CHOCOLATE - 80's
🕘 Sun 16:00 → 05:00 · 📍 SALA APOLO
📊 no public headcount (DICE doesn't publish one)
💶 €19.51
💬 Barcelona's best-known Sunday party, 80s edition: pop hits, drag shows and a very mixed, friendly crowd from mid-afternoon. No public headcount, but it is a long-running night that regularly fills Apolo; expect well over a thousand.
https://dice.fm/event/8e97g7-churros-con-chocolate-80s-29th-nov-sala-apolo-barcelona-tickets

2. SOCIAL LAB X BUS HEXPERIENCE
🕘 Sun 12:00 → 22:00 · 📍 BUS Hexperience
📊 213 interested on RA
💬 All-day vinyl session of house and electronic with food and an outdoor space, noon to 22:00. A relaxed daytime party for a group; RA interest suggests a few hundred across the day.
https://ra.co/events/2585477

3. Salsa & Latin Vibes
🕘 Sun 18:00 → 22:00 · 📍 La Paloma
📊 #1 of 18 on Xceed by popularity · venue has 64 followers on Xceed
💶 €13.50–95
💬 Live salsa band and DJs in La Paloma's old ballroom, 18:00 to 22:00. Top of Xceed's ranking for the day and a big room; expect a couple of hundred dancers, mixed ages and levels.
https://xceed.me/en/barcelona/event/salsa-latin-vibes-75/251363

4. Sunday Night Comedy
🕘 Sun 20:00 → 21:45 · 📍 The Clubhouse: Laietana & Nikki's, Ciutat Vella
📊 organiser has 1,929 followers on Eventbrite
💶 €9.10–11.32
💬 English-language stand-up at the Comedy Clubhouse, a weekly show with an international crowd. No headcount published; it is a small room, likely 50–80, so book ahead.
https://www.eventbrite.es/e/sunday-night-comedy-tickets-1995910141963

Scanned: RA 63 · DICE 27 · Xceed 18 · Eventbrite 147 · Luma 4 · Instagram 27 posts + 16 stories (partial). Not available today: Meetup (every request failed).
